The 64/256/384-square scan regions used 4/14/20 of 27 shards at 0.147/0.381/0.574 s loader p50, while the no-frame-span negative control read all shards and is explicitly non-selective; intra-shard byte-range and arbitrary-position support remain pending

The final raw retained run measured 7.500 ms plus 14.100 ms readback/full validation and retained a 21.200 ms tiny-repeat outlier.
